description: The bundled New task window only (task.html). It lists the projects / boards the user may write to and creates an issue through Rust (GET /api/v1/capture-destinations, GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/config, POST /api/v1/boards/{id}/items with the stored app token); the page never sees a token or a URL, and commands take only ids of the server's last answers. No events.
